# Team Meeting Cadence

Tags: #team #process

## Weekly

Monday 10:30 UTC is planning, 30 minutes. Wednesday 15:00 UTC is the architecture sync where ADRs are reviewed. Friday 14:00 UTC is a 20-minute demo and retrospective on the week's incidents.

## Monthly

The ops review is held on the first Thursday: alert noise labels, post-mortem action item status, cost report, and capacity forecast. It is run by the on-call lead of the previous month. Attendance of one engineer per squad is the minimum.

## Quarterly

Planning happens in the last week of the quarter, together with the access review and a DR game day. Roadmap is written down in the quarterly goals page.

## Meeting Rules

Every meeting needs an agenda in the invite and notes posted in the channel within one day. A meeting without notes is assumed not to have happened. Optional attendees may skip and read notes.
